items.ti: RT @realDonaldTrump저녁 7시 5분의 군중은 422,000명이었습니다! 날씨 때문에 모두 떠나야 했고, 행사도 취소됐고, 번개 때문에 모두 사라졌다. 취소되었다는 소식을 듣고 바로 그 결정을 뒤집고, 사람들이 돌아올 때까지 잠시 기다렸습니다. 놀랍게도 적어도 150,000명이 돌아왔고, 평소보다 훨씬 더 멋진 저녁이었습니다! 압박감에 시달리는 모습을 보여줬습니다. 그토록 빠른 속도로 많은 사람들을 경기장으로 다시 데려올 수 있게 된 비밀경호국과 법 집행 기관에 축하를 보냅니다! 불꽃놀이가 끝난 직후에 비가 쏟아져 더욱 멋진 저녁이었습니다! 도널드 J. 트럼프 대통령
items.ti_en: RT @realDonaldTrumpThe Crowd at 7:05 in the evening was 422,000 people! All were forced to leave because of the weather, the event was cancelled, and everyone was gone because of lightning. When I heard that it was cancelled, I immediately overturned that decision, and waited a while for people to come back. Incredibly, at least 150,000 people returned, and it was an even more spectacular evening than it would have been as normalized! It showed work under pressure. Congratulations to the Secret Service and Law Enforcement on being able to get so many people back into the Arena in such rapid fashion! It was an amazing evening made even more spectacular by the fact that, immediately after the Great Fireworks ended, the rains came down, full blast! President DONALD J. TRUMP
